places.name: Voronet Monastery (Blue Church)
places.ai_summary: Voronet Monastery is famous for its vivid blue frescoes and is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
places.place_tip: Hire a guide to learn about the frescoes’ history.

places.name: Sucevita Monastery
places.ai_summary: Sucevita Monastery is a fortified church known for its green frescoes and unique architectural style.
places.place_tip: Visit during weekdays to avoid crowds.

places.name: Moldovita Monastery
places.ai_summary: Moldovita Monastery is renowned for its beautiful exterior frescoes, especially the 'The Ladder of Virtue'.
places.place_tip: Don't miss the interior paintings and the museum.

places.name: Humor Monastery
places.ai_summary: Humor Monastery is famous for its well-preserved frescoes and beautiful wooden church.
places.place_tip: Explore the surrounding cemetery with its unique tombstones.

places.name: Putna Monastery (Stephen the Great’s Tomb)
places.ai_summary: Putna Monastery is the burial site of Stephen the Great, a key figure in Romanian history.
places.place_tip: Visit the museum to learn about Stephen the Great’s life.

attribution.title: Grădina Edenului numită Putna impresionată de astrul de foc

attribution.description: În soarele ce merge spre asfințit împrejurimile Mănăstirii Putna apar drept Raiul pe pământ.

places.name: Arbore Monastery
places.ai_summary: Arbore Monastery is known for its impressive frescoes and beautiful location.
places.place_tip: The monastery is active, so be respectful of the services.

places.name: Dragomirna Monastery
places.ai_summary: Dragomirna Monastery is notable for its tall bell tower and beautiful frescoes.
places.place_tip: Climb the bell tower for a great view of the area.

attribution.title: Dragomirna monastery sunset
attribution.author: Alessio Damato
attribution.description: View of the Dagomirna monastery during the sunset

places.name: Cacica Salt Mine
places.ai_summary: Cacica Salt Mine is an underground salt mine with a chapel and a small lake.

opening_hours.notes: Wear warm clothes; the temperature is low inside.

places.place_tip: Take a guided tour to learn about the salt extraction process.

places.name: Rarau Mountains Scenic Drive
places.ai_summary: Rarau Mountains Scenic Drive offers breathtaking views of the mountains and valleys.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the day for the views.

places.place_tip: Drive carefully and stop at the viewpoints.

attribution.title: Rarău massif in winter
attribution.author: Liviu Mihai Șeiciuc
attribution.description: Rarău Massif, with the Pietrele Doamnei stones visible and the main peak to the far left.

places.name: Suceava Fortress
places.ai_summary: Suceava Fortress is a medieval fortress with impressive ruins and panoramic views.

opening_hours.notes: Wear comfortable shoes for walking on uneven surfaces.

places.place_tip: Visit the museum inside the fortress for more history.

places.name: Ethnographic Museum of Bukovina
places.ai_summary: Ethnographic Museum of Bukovina showcases the traditional life and crafts of the Bukovina region.
places.place_tip: Check for traditional craft demonstrations.

places.name: Painted Monasteries Route
places.ai_summary: The Painted Monasteries Route is a UNESCO World Heritage site, famous for its monasteries with exterior frescoes.
places.place_tip: Start early to visit all monasteries in one day.

places.name: Gura Humorului Park & Viewpoint
places.ai_summary: Gura Humorului Park & Viewpoint offers a panoramic view of the Humorului Valley and the surrounding mountains.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Bring binoculars for bird watching.

places.name: Vatra Dornei Spa Town
places.ai_summary: Vatra Dornei is a popular spa town known for its thermal baths and ski resorts.

opening_hours.notes: Check the schedule for thermal bath hours.

places.place_tip: Try the local cuisine in the town.

places.name: Vatra Moldoviței Craft Shops
places.ai_summary: Vatra Moldoviței is known for its traditional craft shops, especially for handmade wooden objects.
places.place_tip: Look for unique souvenirs and gifts.

places.name: Bucovina Village Museum
places.ai_summary: Bucovina Village Museum is an open-air museum showcasing traditional Bucovina houses and lifestyle.
places.place_tip: Join a guided tour for detailed information.

places.name: Suceava City Center Walk
places.ai_summary: Suceava City Center Walk is a pleasant walk through the historical center of Suceava.

opening_hours.notes: Best enjoyed at a leisurely pace.

places.place_tip: Explore the side streets for hidden gems.

places.name: Câmpulung Moldovenesc Ethno Museum
places.ai_summary: Câmpulung Moldovenesc Ethno Museum exhibits the ethnography and folk art of the Bukovina region.
places.place_tip: Check for traditional music and dance performances.

places.name: Painted Eggs Museum (Vama)
places.ai_summary: Painted Eggs Museum in Vama displays a unique collection of intricately decorated eggs.
places.place_tip: Look for the egg with the tree of life motif.

places.name: Voronet Sunset Photography Point
places.ai_summary: Voronet Sunset Photography Point is a popular spot for capturing the sunset behind the Voronet Monastery.
places.place_tip: Arrive early to secure a good spot for photography.
